_comment: PR-specific demo for the distance-squared optimization: SelectionManager._can_form_up, one of the three call sites converted from distance_to to distance_squared_to, is the check that decides whether this right-drag deploys the selection along the dragged line. Two Infantry regiments are box-selected (box release lands DRAG_TICKS=16 after its tick), then a 280 wu right-to-left drag at y=440 (facing +y) clears the two-unit threshold of FORM_UP_MIN_WIDTH + MULTI_FORM_UP_GAP = 36 wu by a wide margin, so both units deploy along the line. Drill mode: the player gesture is the subject, no enemy needed. Replay.record_pointer, the second optimized call site, dedups the pointer track this recording writes.
